svg.title: How Request, req_to_blocks, KVCacheBlock and the KV cache connect
svg.desc: In EngineCore, the Request object holds the request state but no block IDs. req_to_blocks in KVCacheManager maps the request ID to its KVCacheBlock objects, here blocks 7 and 12 for request A, which has 16 computed tokens. Every KVCacheBlock lives in BlockPool.blocks and holds only metadata such as ref_cnt and the block hash. Block 0 is the null block. The scheduler sends new block IDs to the worker in SchedulerOutput, the worker keeps them in BlockTables, and a block ID is the index of the block in the KV cache tensor of each layer on the GPU.
